scope: Current immutable lazy combo scripts, source maps and asynchronous carriers

Mutable maps are independently reset for each consumer. Initial fixture bytes are hashed in fixture-inputs.json.

verification.native: 11 passed; current resources/registry, historical Loader carrier and actual canonical Desktop runtime consumers.

verification.scope_reason: Selected cases exercise first map GET, HEAD, malformed map fallback, immutable responses across unrelated graph recomposition, source-map section offsets and actual standard Source Map consumer. Native additionally checks shared concurrent producer rejection/retry and cancellation of one carrier without cancelling another consumer.

behavior: Entry composition reads only the built script. Maps remain unread during startup, script GET and HEAD. Script and map bodies have independent shared lazy producers.
Successful bodies retain their exact bytes; rejection drops the lazy result for retry. Python cancellation shields the shared producer, an explicit carrier adaptation to Source Promise ownership.
Responses are retained by advertised URL across graph recomposition; one prior startup batch generation remains addressable. Snapshot bundle bytes are captured by each lazy artifact.
Map responses use compact Source JSON and sourceMappingURL references resolve against the script directory. Missing, malformed or invalid authored maps retain generated identity sections.
Current fetchBundle is asynchronous; the optional Web writer awaits it and the Desktop consumer accepts both current async and historical sync providers.

cleanup.retained: Paired response bodies, fixture hashes, logs, XML, selected Source report, commands and cleanup receipts. Source/toolchains remain migration-owned through C9.

limitations: This is targeted completion only. Split chunks and package assets remain subsequent work; current registry is not yet promoted.
URL relocation coverage currently includes the selected standard authored/generated cases, not all WHATWG URL edge cases.
No complete regression, Portable/browser/Win7 acceptance or upstream promotion is established.
